warnings: Third-floor beams of S-05. Grid ids from the A-09 bubbles. Printed chains: x 1.50 + 20 x 4.00 + 1.50; y 1.50 / 2.50 / 5.50 / 2.50 / 1.50 both sides; at the stair bays 1.50 (D to D'') and 2.00 (D to D''').

Differences from floor 2 (S-04): no toilet bays (grids 1/21 carry B15 A-C and HC planks in bays 1-2 / 20-21); no D-E stair projection (the stair bays only step 2.00 past D: B5 on D'', R5 on D''', both on the B11/1 cantilevers); bays 1-4 and 18-21 of the C-D strip carry hand-written HC planks and the row-C beam there is a hand-overwritten B1.
Grid 11 is drawn as a long centre line through the dimension row, and the B10 / R6 labels are printed twice on either side of it — one beam per line, recorded once.
Grid lines 4/5/17/18 A-B are labelled 'B8/B6' on this sheet (B8 on S-04). Recorded with the printed compound mark; which of the two details applies is not stated.
B3 on line B'''''''''''''''' is taken at 5.45 like floor 2 (S-13 / S-14 stair sections); S-05 itself prints no dimension for it.
Bx (pipe-duct box outside A1 / A21): placed on dummy lines scaled from the grid, same as S-03 / S-04 (confidence 0.6); the unmarked outer vertical has element_id null.
R5 / R5/1 / R1 / R1/1 sit on the R6 / R4 / R3 cantilever tips — bears_on_beam flags list them.
